compareDisposition.rationale: The curator examined Jerusalem’s king and treasures are carried away beside The land is said to vomit out its inhabitants; Scattering is threatened and covenant is remembered; The wilderness generation is refused entry; Scattering and seeking are held together. Those passages share its Eden-and-exile evidence group or canonical movement, but none supplies a distinct two-source relationship stronger than the accepted comparisons already carrying this topic.
